WITH gender_counts AS (
  SELECT c.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT i.order_id) AS invoiced_orders
  FROM Customers c
  JOIN Orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  JOIN Invoices i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
  GROUP BY c.gender
), overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(invoiced_orders * 1.0) AS avg_orders
  FROM gender_counts
)
SELECT AVG(gc.invoiced_orders * 1.0) AS average_figure,
       AVG(gc.invoiced_orders * 1.0 - oa.avg_orders) AS average_excess
FROM gender_counts gc
CROSS JOIN overall_average oa
WHERE gc.invoiced_orders > oa.avg_orders;
